brief:
The United Nations has called for increased funding of humanitarian operations in Gaza and demanded access for essential supplies, Shehab Wire reported. The organization warned of compounding effects from winter conditions alongside deteriorating humanitarian circumstances amid ongoing military escalation across the territory.

UN officials cited the convergence of seasonal hardship and intensified fighting as factors threatening to deepen the crisis. The agency stressed the urgency of permitting aid deliveries to reach affected populations.

title: UN warns of worsening humanitarian crisis in Gaza
